Petition for a Writ of Mandamus
to the United States District Court
for the Eastern District of Louisiana
USDC No. 2:25-CV-1127
ON PETITION FOR REHEARING EN BANC
UNPUBLISHED ORDER
Before SMITH, HAYNES, and OLDHAM, Circuit Judges.
PER CURIAM:
Treating the petition for rehearing en banc as a motion for
reconsideration (5TH CIR. R. 40 1.O.P.), the motion for reconsideration
is DENIED. Because no member of the panel or judge in regular active
service requested that the court be polled on rehearing en banc (FED. R.
App. P. 40 and 5TH CIR. R. 40), the petition for rehearing en banc is
DENIED. Petitioner's motions filed on October 21, 2025, and October 24,
2025, are DENIED AS MOOT.
